CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real proof-of-concept for dlopen-based mod loading (apps/dynmod_poc): a real, standalone tool dlopens/dlsyms a real PARENA-compiled mod function built as a shared library, proving the mechanism works with zero mod-file changes and zero host rebuild. Found and fixed a real Bazel gotcha along the way (alwayslink needed to preserve symbols across --start-lib/--end-lib archive resolution). Verified fully clean (bazel clean + plain build/test, no special flags): 21 targets, 8/8 mod tests, real regression check on apps/server passes. Commit 5bb7696. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
